title: Tech Note: Contact Manager II
author: Hugo Fournier
featured_technology: GET OBJECT RECT / MOVE OBJECT for selection-rectangle highlighting
DRAG AND DROP PROPERTIES / On Drag Over / On Drop form events
DUPLICATE RECORD for Shift-drag event copies
Open form window / INPUT FORM / MODIFY RECORD dialog pattern

historical_commentary.text: Hugo Fournier (4D Technical Support Engineer) documents the interaction/event-handling half of the Contact Manager sample's hand-built calendar widget, covering click selection, drag-and-drop event moving/duplicating, and the add/edit dialog flow, as a companion to Part I's object-placement note. The technique of tracking parallel arrays to map form objects to records and manually drawing selection rectangles reflects classic Design Mode form programming; it still functions today, but modern 4D development would typically use a List Box or a dedicated calendar/plug-in component instead of hand-managing dozens of named objects and drag rectangles, so the pattern is now mainly of educational/historical value.
related_updates: Modern 4D calendar UIs are more commonly built with List Box objects, calendar plug-ins, or web/JS calendar components rather than dozens of individually named form objects
The classic Design Mode form-object and drag-and-drop event techniques shown still function in current 4D versions
The Contact Manager sample database referenced is no longer part of 4D's current example/download library
